items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 July 2026 11:18am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 25 July 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic and low pressure to the northeast of Scotland as weak fronts affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, 6 in the east at first, veering west or northwest 4 or 5 later this afternoon and falling variable 2 to 4 for a time later this evening. Overnight wind settling west or southwest 5 or 6 before veering west or northwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight for a time, then slight or moderate again later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 in places, backing west 4 or 5 overnight into Monday, backing west or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
